title: Sharing Delta tables with deletion vectors and column mapping is now generally available
body: Sharing Delta tables with [deletion vectors](/aws/en/tables/features/deletion-vectors) or [column mapping](/aws/en/tables/features/column-mapping) enabled is now generally available. See [Add tables with deletion vectors or column mapping to a share](/aws/en/opensharing/create-share#deletion-vectors).

ref_links.text: Add tables with deletion vectors or column mapping to a share
